column1: # tests/audio/pattern.csv
# Trigger / clock pattern for the golden-audio regression
# (bead rackboy-5wl). Binds AD #11's render window to an
# explicit event stream:
#   * Total window: 2.000 s (96000 samples at 48 kHz).
#   * Column schema per tests/audio/README.md "Trigger / clock pattern":
#       time_seconds
#     where event_value for gate1_rising is "p1
#     the four instrument-slot indices to select on Pulse1
#     Pulse2
#     fixture (rackboy-pj3) has pool counts {2
#     tests/fixtures/expected.json
#     0 (no-instrument) for the whole render.
# First row MUST be a gate1_rising at t=0 with an explicit
# slot tuple (README "First-row rule"). This pattern keeps
# the slot tuple fixed — knob_set is not exercised — and
# interleaves Gate 1 retriggers with steady Gate 2 clocks
# so the table interpreter advances per-voice cursors at
# ~8 Hz (every 125 ms) across the render.
# Lines beginning with `#` are comments and are ignored by
# the parser. Empty lines are ignored too. Whitespace around
# commas is trimmed. Order within a single timestamp is
# deterministic: gate1_rising is applied before gate2_rising
# when they share the same timestamp
# ASSESS/EXECUTE loop of tests/audio/regression.cpp.
